about: The boxers built from the owner's meshes on 2026-10-01, and what makes each one itself. tools/build_roster.py reads this. 'age' is muscle strength beside a trained adult's and 'speed' is joint speed beside one's (1.0 = the same); strength also follows the square of height. 'style' is how the boxer is paid in training: the keys are listed in envs/boxing.py where they are read.
veterans_about: Matt and Zombie were trained before the roster existed, from rigs read off the skeleton alone. 'build_roster.py --all' derives them from their meshes like everybody else. Zombie's height is the one his first rig had: his file is not in metres. Matt's mass is given (the owner's choice, 2026-10-02): his mesh has surfaces inside it and measures 147 litres, where the shapes fitted inside it hold 85.

trump.says: comes forward, big slow shots to the head, little guard
trump.style_note: 2026-10-03 17:05, the new mesh after its first match round: range 0.72 -> 0.60 and press 0.25 -> 0.4. Shoulder to wrist is 0.44 m, the shortest in the roster (the others 0.48 to 0.54); at 0.72 he landed 1.09 a second on Zombie and 0.71 on Nick, who come to him, and 0.00 to 0.02 on Matt, Grandma and Grandpa, who do not.

grandma.says: tight guard, stops the punch, answers with quick shots to the body

grandpa.says: stays at the end of his reach, patient, works behind the left hand
grandpa.style_note: 2026-10-02 04:00, after round 3: taken 1.4 -> 1.0 and crowd 0.8 -> 0.5. As first written he stopped punching in two sessions out of three (with Grandma, then with Lil Matt): a boxer charged that much for a punch taken, at a range few opponents can reach, does best by doing nothing.

nick.says: always closing, many light fast punches

kim.says: fast and agile: quick light combinations from the end of her reach, then gone; circles off the ropes
kim.style_note: 2026-10-14, the owner: 'a fast and agile woman'. Mass 54 kg as PoOlympic has her (the mesh's volume, with its loose top, reads 106 litres); height 1.65 m chosen, the file is not in metres. Her gauntlet also runs the ring-craft rope charge (--rope-w), which no other boxer trains with. 2026-10-15 00:00, after m1_kim (attack 0.14 a second at 1.1 m/s; footing, guard, chin, get-up and carrying on passed): power 0.6 -> 1.0, taken 1.5 -> 0.9, crowd 0.6 -> 0.2, press 0.1 -> 0.3, range 0.78 -> 0.72. As first written she guarded (71% of head shots stopped) and hardly punched: Grandpa's lesson again. 02:50, after m3_kim (bag first; 1.11 a second, but at 3.4 m/s: 2.7 to 3.1 a second on Nick and Trump, nothing on Grandma, Grandpa and Matt, who stand off): press 0.3 -> 0.6.

sokol.says: a stiff jab and the straight right behind it; balanced, walks his man down to the ropes
sokol.style_note: 2026-10-15, the owner's Sokol_TPose character (plaid shirt, jeans); in metres, 1.83 m. Mass 82 kg given: the mesh's volume reads 123 litres (BMI 36). Persona chosen to fill the roster's gap; Kim's lessons kept from the start: power and press up, taken under 1, so standing off does not pay.

timmy.says: the body-snatcher: slips inside, lives at close range and digs hooks to the body off the lead hand
timmy.style_note: 2026-11-16, the owner's TIMMY_unity_rigged (AccuRig FBX, staged in BLENDER/2026-11-16_timmy/stage.py: animation dropped, mesh moved onto its skeleton by the skin weights, legs straightened from 27 degrees apart, 1.76 m). Persona chosen to fill the roster's gap: no one else lives inside (range 0.56 m, the shortest) or is paid most for the body (2.0) and the lead hand (1.3). Kim's and Grandpa's lessons kept from the start: taken 0.7 and press 0.8, so standing off does not pay.

soldat.says: the sniper: disciplined, long and upright, picks his shot and fires the straight right hand to the head
soldat.style_note: 2026-11-16, the owner's soldat_unity.fbx: no skeleton and no weights, rigged in BLENDER/2026-11-16_soldat/rig.py (joints found from the mesh, Mixamo names, heat weights; hip and knee at the usual fractions of height because the trouser legs touch high on the thigh), 1.84 m. Persona chosen to fill the roster's gap: no one else is paid for the rear hand (hand_r 1.6) or works from as far out with it (0.84 m). Grandpa's lesson kept: taken 1.0 and press 0.3, so standing off at a range nobody reaches does not pay.
